summary: End-to-end test of Astitva Real Estate platform (backend + frontend). 32/32 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend public + admin + RBAC flows working correctly.

issues: Right-side thumbnail boxes appear empty/dark when a seeded property has only 1 image - placeholder boxes are rendered even when there is no 2nd/3rd image. Consider hiding empty thumbnails or using a skeleton tile.
Property row thumbnail squares render as solid dark placeholders when the image URL doesn't load or is empty; add fallback image or aspect-ratio placeholder.

action_items: Optional UX polish: hide empty image-gallery thumbnails on property detail page when fewer than 3 images exist.
Optional UX polish: render an explicit image fallback in AdminPropertiesPage thumbnail cells when image fails to load.
Consider clearing TEST_ prefixed users created by pytest from previous runs (/api/users) — they currently linger on Admin Users page.
critical_code_review_comments: All public APIs correctly strip Mongo _id from responses.
RBAC enforced both at API (403 for sales on user CRUD & property delete) and at UI (Users nav hidden, no delete buttons rendered for sales).
Brute-force lockout responding with 429/401 properly on wrong password (verified in test).
Seed properties (6) only visible publicly when status=='published' — confirmed draft created via admin API was NOT exposed via /api/properties.
Object Storage upload + serve roundtrip works (uploaded PNG returned correct PNG bytes via /api/files/{path}).
test_credentials: admin: admin@astitva.com / Astitva@2026 (seeded). sales: test_sales_user@astitva.com / Sales@2026 (created by backend_test.py fixture, persistent).
seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture creates a sales user (test_sales_user@astitva.com) once for RBAC testing. Lifecycle test creates+deletes TEST_user_{ts}@astitva.com on each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) is the source of truth — 32 tests cover auth, properties (public+admin), leads, users RBAC, upload+serve. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Public URL: https://github-executor-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend uses cookie + Bearer fallback; when scripting Playwright, prefer click-navigation after login rather than full page.goto to avoid auth-state race. data-testids are present on hero/sections/forms/admin tables — full list grep-able in /app/frontend/src. Sales user persists; admin users list will accumulate TEST_ entries over runs.
rca_of_the_issue: No critical issues found. Minor design observations only.
